basic_info.description: Welcome to 535 Leland Ave, a charming semi-detached home nestled in the heart of the vibrant Visitacion Valley neighborhood. Built in 1999, this well-maintained residence offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and cozy living across two spacious levels.  The upper level features a desirable layout with three sun-filled bedrooms and two well-appointed bathrooms. Each bedroom boasts large windows that offer serene views of the beautifully landscaped backyardan ideal space for outdoor relaxation. The bedrooms are equipped with ample closet space, and the freshly painted interiors enhance the warm, inviting atmosphere.  The home's thoughtful design ensures abundant natural light throughout, creating a bright and welcoming environment for family and guests alike.  With its prime location, you'll enjoy convenient access to nearby parks, shops, restaurants, and excellent public transportation options.
